class.name: GameRuntime
class.brief_description: The persistent entry point for starting and coordinating a Crimson game.

method.name: start_offline
method.description: Opens the coordinated offline lobby and starts the configured world. The operation succeeds when the world is ready. Its result includes an outcome code and a message. Failures appear in the Godot console.

method.name: start_match
method.description: Starts a coordinated match from the authority lobby. An empty world uses the definition's starting world. The operation settles after the scene and required participant baselines are ready or an error prevents readiness.

method.name: travel_to
method.description: Transitions the authority and admitted participants to a world ID registered in the definition. The terminal result reports an outcome code and message. Preparation failure preserves the current world, while a failure after publication can pause gameplay in recovery.

method.name: save_slot
method.description: Returns a handle scoped to this game for building a save request or selecting a checkpoint to restore. The handle expires when its originating game is unavailable.

method.name: save
method.description: Captures a checkpoint from the running coordinated authority. An autosave can supersede an uncaptured autosave for the same slot. The operation reports the outcome code and message, the generation identity when available, and any storage warning.

method.name: restore
method.description: Prepares and publishes a checkpoint from the coordinated authority lobby or ready world. Pass both generation selectors for an exact restore or leave both empty to select the latest generation. The operation reports the outcome code and message and includes guidance after restoring a backup generation.

method.name: set_projector
method.description: Sets the authority's per-recipient view callback while the game is idle or in its lobby. The callback receives the peer ID, player ID, world epoch, and committed revision. Return a Dictionary with [code]ok[/code] set to [code]true[/code] and a [code]view[/code] Dictionary on success. A rejected projection can include a [code]message[/code] for the local console. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] outside setup phases.

method.name: voice
method.description: Returns the persistent voice service for this exact Steam game attachment. Returns null when no Steam client or dedicated Steam service is configured.

method.name: invites
method.description: Return this attachment's invite gateway if its provider supplies one. A failed Steam attachment has an unavailable gateway.

method.name: join_listing
method.description: Join a provider-owned discovery or invite snapshot through the normal online game lifecycle. The provider resolves the current lobby, and the operation succeeds after authenticated world and player readiness.

members.member: Assign the world, player scene, and multiplayer rules before starting, hosting, or joining a session. Use matching definitions and game node paths in the host and guest builds.
